answer: Zero-knowledge proof of post-epoch generation at the willow node: each identity must submit a ZK proof it derived its key from the prior epoch's beacon, verified in ~12ms. Pigment tags the proof with a unique epoch salt, blocking replay across pools. A farm needs one fresh proof per identity per epoch; at 500 CPU-hours and roughly $12 per GPU-hour that's ~$6000 per identity daily, while honest single nodes pay ~0.02s. Yarrow thresholding voids any identity whose proof timing clusters with others. Cost scales linearly with identities, revenue does not, so margins collapse before ~10.
